verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents processing in 150+ currencies (docs-33), an FX rates API to retrieve indicative rates used for acquiring and payouts (checkout-com-docs-10), and settlement/reconciliation reporting (settlement breakdown, balance reports) plus an option to settle to stablecoin wallets (checkout-com-docs-25). This supports charging locally and understanding FX rates and settlement flows, but there is no explicit documentation of a single consolidated 'settle everything to your one home-currency bank account' guarantee or a transparent markup/margin disclosure beyond the rates API. Missing for 10: explicit multi-currency-to-single-settlement-currency conversion mechanics, disclosed FX markup/margin transparency, and independent confirmation of real-world settlement behavior.
